key_gap: vs baseline: the human baseline owned the premise interrogation on its home turf (definition of 'unprofitable' → elenchus counterexample X/Y → reformulated question → flipped decision; 4.7/5), while the non-routed v5 AI accepted the proxy as authoritative and cut X (2.6/5, destroying $1,350/mo of the exact contribution the CEO objective demands). The routed run installed the m016 premise-interrogation pass as a first-class contract (question tree before answers: definitions, unexamined premises, implications; elenchus; reformulation) anchored by m001 fundamentals + measured-data calibration, synthesized with m018 steel-manning (which priced a demand-fragility/obsolescence residual the human baseline never addressed → demand-trend check), and bounded by the m003 inversion gate (6 ranked failure categories, residual, never/always) and m007 ruin screen (reversibility: no one-shot premium; p=1 arithmetic on measured inputs). Every rubric point is reproduced and extended. Residual shared gap: demand-trend risk is unmeasured — the trend check is planned, not executed.
learning_signal: On decide/maximize signatures where an operative term ('unprofitable', 'underperforming', 'critical') arrives pre-defined while the decision objective is stated separately, the definitional-interrogation pass must be first-class and contract-complete: (1) name the operative term and its supplied definition, (2) ask what it means relative to the stated objective (who benefits from the proxy?), (3) construct a data-based counterexample that falsifies the definitional equivalence (a case the rule cuts that outperforms cases it keeps), (4) reformulate the decision question, (5) only then apply or flip. A pass that applies a given rule without the counterexample check has not run (rule 36). Pair with the never/always reframing and a reversibility/ruin check so the flipped decision is also bounded, and steel-man the proxy before discarding it — a legitimate residual (e.g., demand fragility) may survive the elenchus.
suggested_improvement: Keep m001+m016 dual-route with m018 synthesis on finance/product decide-maximize signatures (router confident=no — the counterexample pass is the difference between 2.6 and 4.9); make 'counterexample against the stated objective' a standing m016 contract item and 'reversibility/ruin check' a standing m007 gate line; the v5 definitional-interrogation gate between WHAT and WHY remains installed, now enforced by the pass contract; add demand-trend check as a mandatory packet line whenever steel-manning surfaces a legitimate proxy residual.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure Socratic baseline never committed (2.3/5) — it interrogated 'cause' (correlation is not causation), 'outage' (threshold undefined), 'recovery' (undefined), and the urgency itself, burning 10+ minutes at $8K/min while the dominant answer (roll back: leading hypothesis, reversible, $32K worst case) was available at T+2. The non-routed v5 AI already committed at T+2 (4.7/5); the routed run keeps that and adds the m021 OODA tempo contract (observe/orient/decide/act with the outage as an opponent bleeding $8K/min; commit at DO under P2), the m084 coordination reading (the on-call debate is consensus-seeking/diffusion of responsibility; the commander's authority ends it; rollback is the coordination default), and the m007 ruin screen (full distribution 0.7/0.3; in-window decision is one-shot in time → no waiting premium; 0.7 disclosed as judgment with provenance, not measurement). The deferred inquiry — m094 critical reading of the timeline (definitions, thresholds, causation) — is explicitly scheduled for the postmortem. Residual: the 30% wrong-rollback probability is a judgment, not a measurement; no faster in-window test exists.
learning_signal: On decide/diagnose + deadline signatures, the correct discipline is act-then-question, not question-then-act: one hypothesis-framing pass, one EV comparison that prices 'do nothing' and 'investigate first' at the per-unit delay cost, commit at DO (tempo mode), then schedule the definitional/causal questions for after stabilization. 'Waiting for certainty' is a priced option whose EV ≤ 0 whenever delay cost exceeds the expected error cost of the leading-hypothesis action; continued questioning is the most expensive option on the table in-window and ≈ free after. Inquiry is re-budgeted, not abandoned — the postmortem is where the Socratic reading of the evidence belongs, and a coordination reading (who owns the decision, what the debate costs per minute) is part of the answer, not decoration.
suggested_improvement: Keep m021+m084 dual-route with m094 synthesis on deadline-incident signatures (router confident=no — the trap style's endless-interrogation failure is exactly what this route avoids); retain m007 ruin screen as the standing gate for high_stakes context on tempo-mode tasks; make 'deferred-inquiry plan' a mandatory decision-packet line on every tempo decision (which definitional questions are scheduled, for when); the m016-style interrogation passes must detect a hard deadline in the frame and hand their questions to the postmortem rather than the decision window.
